approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and email content.
notes: Enterprise mail gateways commonly prepend bounded bracketed labels such as [EXTERNAL] or [External Email] before or between reply/forward prefixes.
Keep explicit RFI/Submittal words and digit-bearing identifiers mandatory, reuse Python regular expressions, add no dependency, and advance the parser version.
title: Enterprise email Subject prefix support
objective: Recognize explicit RFI and Submittal email Subjects behind a bounded sequence of reply, forward and bracketed enterprise security labels without weakening identifier or routing rules.
